contract.native-host: Native PCM preparation and exact prefix check, input decode once per complete sequence, all variant predictions, one counted IDR fence, ALL named host outputs and exact comparison. No resets between variants.
contract.cpu: Native/unrolled -O3 single-threaded independent supplied-field kernels, returning and checking all compact luma outputs. Reusable contexts allocated before timing; no result cache. Common interpolation planes are not shared across separate variant contexts.
contract.prepared-host: Input PCM supplied pre-encoded, but input decode and every requested host result still timed.
contract.prepared-complete: Unequal-result diagnostic: input decode and all predictions/fence, zero host results, no GPU consumer. Four NEW full-I420 requests postflight outside timing do not observe earlier unread pixels.
contract.excluded: Reusable allocation, pipeline create, one warmup, postflight, final fence drain/close. Per-sequence input decode is included. Setup/warmup/close wall times recorded.
contract.accounting: Parent and live worker process CPU, including threads; excludes other processes/IRQs/kernel workqueues. No energy inference.
contract.scope: Finite multi-output batch throughput, not interactive retained-reference completion. This measured path uses existing fenced requests; separate streaming probe tests no-reset output availability.
contract.ordering: CPU once per workload/size/output-count; six decoder mode/policy variants, five rotated and alternately reversed repeats.
contract.normalization: wall_ms_per_job and cpu_ms_per_job refer to the WHOLE output set; per-output values divide by the explicitly recorded output count.
